name: Quail Hollow RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 40.7196,-94.6765: the RV loop sits on open ground east of the office; the pond the three 'Water's Edge' sites face is ~50 m off the pads and the rest of the park is away from water; default down - not waterfront

name: Trailhead Cabins and Camping
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 42.4041,-93.0805: the sites ring a small decorative pond beside the buildings; the Iowa River is ~250 m south behind a treeline and fields - not waterfront

name: Wild Oak Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 42.1928,-93.5764: gravel rows of RV pads in an open wooded lot east of the Skunk River's wooded bottom, ~250 m from the river - not waterfront

name: DeSoto Bend RV Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 41.5520,-96.0291: a small treed lot of pads north of US-30 surrounded by cropland; DeSoto Lake is ~2 km west - not waterfront

name: Loess Hills Hideaway Cabins & Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 41.8656,-95.8513: a gravel loop of sites in an opening in hillside woods; the only water is a creek-side pond ~350 m east across the road - not waterfront

name: Whispering Maples Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 240 m frame) at 41.2405,-91.1935: sandy pads under a block of trees beside the farm buildings; a farm pond ~120 m west is not at the sites - not waterfront

name: Beaver Lake Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 41.5284,-94.2147: three gravel loops in a mown lot across the road from the lake's grassy south shore; the water is ~200 m north beyond scrub - not waterfront

name: Olde Massey Station Campground & RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 42.4305,-90.5982: a single gravel loop with a dozen rigs above the valley road; a creek runs ~100 m south beyond the road and trees - not waterfront

name: Bluffton Resort & Bar
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 43.4026,-91.9137: sites spread around the bar and office on open ground; the Upper Iowa River is 150-200 m west and south behind trees, and the operator's own site descriptions say 'near water but not waterfront' - not waterfront

name: Deer Ridge Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 42.8286,-91.6599: two gravel loops packed with rigs east of the highway; the south loop rings a small pond (~60 m across) but most sites are in the north loop away from water - default down
